criteria.description: transcript-watch-error.test.ts: all 4 tests pass — directory-at-transcript-path surfaces the 'Transcript unavailable' frame once and still recovers with a real snapshot
criteria.detail: Fixed in transcript-watch.ts: a stat-isDirectory check in attemptInstall emits the friendly error frame and keeps a native watcher that installs the engine once a readable transcript replaces the directory.

criteria.description: service.test.ts: all 71 tests pass — built request options default allowUsagePanelSupplement to true, omit the proxy key when unconfigured, and allow PTY fallback for managed WSL targets
criteria.detail: Fixed in service.ts: resolveClaudeFetchOptions defaults the supplement on and spreads the proxy key only when set; shouldAllowClaudePtyFallback now permits managed WSL targets on Windows.

criteria.description: orca-runtime-files.test.ts: all 79 tests pass — the IPv4-loopback terminal link joins to the correct absolutePath, and the WSL temp-artifact translation no longer hangs
criteria.detail: Fixed in orca-runtime-files.ts: the authority regex first tries the loopback+drive form (//127.0.0.1C:\...) before the generic split, and canonicalPathForArtifactComparison skips realpath for WSL UNC paths that can block on the SMB timeout.

criteria.description: rotating-log-writer.test.ts: all 7 tests pass — a directory log path synchronously reports active: false
criteria.detail: Fixed in rotating-log-writer.ts: open() stat-checks the log path and marks the writer failed when it is a directory, before openSync (which succeeds on Windows directories and only fails on the first write).

criteria.description: monaco-content-sync.undo-history.test.ts: both tests pass — the model value round-trips LF (no unexpected \r\n) and read-only live-tail appends stay non-undoable
criteria.detail: Fixed in monaco-content-sync.ts: syncContentOnMount/syncContentUpdate pin the model to LF (EndOfLineSequence.LF) when its EOL differs, independent of host OS.
